title: Schema: resources section in game-definition.schema.json
description: Add optional resources object to game-definition.schema.json. Resources are named external data files referenced by game definitions. Schema: resources is an object where keys are resource names and values are resource descriptors with type (word_list, lookup_table, image_set) and name (identifier for the specific resource, e.g. twl06, sowpods). No new required fields — games without resources unchanged.
close_reason: Added resources and resource_def to game-definition.schema.json. Schema self-validates, all games pass.
